Origins of the term "Salty"
In fighting games after winning or losing, the sportsmanship thing to do is to shake your opponents hand. With a super small community, sometimes there would be grudges and the winner would be unsportsmanlike and refuse to shake, rubbing it in that he won. Basically "throwing salt on the wound".

For a short period "assaulted" became the term to describe someone who lost and was unsportsmanlike, which along with the above term, became "salted".

Then eventually over time, angry people who lost were considered "salty". As in covered in salt.

Outside the fighting game community, normies used it to mean someone crying/angry because of their tears are salty.
